build.spec_hint: Drop or paste an image; add arrows, boxes, text labels and blur; export the result as PNG.
Enter income and expenses with client and category; shows monthly totals, profit and tax to set aside; export CSV.
Columns of cards you add, edit and drag between columns; saved on the device; export and import JSON.
Type Markdown on one side, see it rendered live; open and save .md files; calm readable typography.
Enter date, marker, value, unit and reference range; table and chart per marker, out-of-range values flagged.
Open or paste a .md file; renders it cleanly with headings, tables, code and a contents sidebar.
Paste two CSV or TSV tables, pick a key column; shows added, removed and changed rows with changed cells highlighted.
Type LOGO commands (FD, RT, REPEAT, TO procedures); a turtle draws on canvas; save the drawing as PNG.
Type field names with bit widths; draws an RFC-style packet header figure; export SVG and ASCII art.
Open a local video; step forward and backward one frame at a time with keys; shows frame number and time.
Type lines like "1969: moon landing"; renders a scaled timeline diagram; export SVG or PNG.
Edit HTML and CSS panes; live preview in a sandboxed frame; download the result as one HTML file.
Pixel grid from 16 to 64 px with palette, pencil, fill and eraser; export PNG and SVG.
Paste text; shows one word at a time at a chosen words-per-minute with a focus letter; pause and rewind.
Open an audio file; decodes it locally and estimates tempo in BPM; tap-tempo button as a cross-check.
Load several photos of the same scene; per-pixel median removes moving people; export the clean PNG.
Place batteries, resistors, bulbs and switches on a grid; solves DC voltages and currents live.
Enter two or three set names and their items; draws a labeled Venn diagram; export SVG or PNG.
Plays a target tone; listens through the microphone and shows how far your sung pitch is in cents.
Random plates drift on a grid world; collisions raise mountains, rifts open oceans; play, pause, speed.
Sliders for CO2, albedo and solar input drive an energy-balance model that plots temperature over years.
Load a map image and set grid square size; splits it across printable pages at true scale with alignment marks.
Add tables and guest names; drag guests onto seats; mark pairs to keep apart; print the chart.
Add question nodes, answers and outcomes; draws the tree; click-through mode to walk it; export SVG.
Enter latitude, longitude and date; computes sunrise, sunset, twilight and day length for the day and month.
Enter location, date and time; draws bright stars and constellation lines above the horizon from an embedded catalog.
Mix generated layers like murmur, rain, brown noise and cup clatter with volume sliders; all sound synthesized.
Load two images; highlights differing pixels, offers a slider overlay and says whether pixels are identical.
Paste or open two JSON documents; structural diff listing added, removed and changed paths with values.
Load CSV files as tables; run SQL SELECT with WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY and JOIN; shows result table.
Paste a string; tries base64, hex, URL, rot13, binary, morse and more; readable results ranked first.
Paste text and a search pattern; every match highlighted in place with a count; regex optional.
Draw boxes, lines, arrows and text on a character grid; copy the drawing as plain text.
Add people, parents and partners; draws a tree that handles remarriage and half-siblings; save JSON, export SVG.
Load an image; simulate protan, deutan and tritan vision and apply a color-separating filter; export PNG.
Hide a message in a PNG's lowest bits and download it; load a PNG to reveal a hidden message.
Write named checklists; run one step by step with check-offs and a reset; saved on the device.
Open a GPX file; shows total distance, elevation gain and loss, moving time, pace and an elevation profile.
Enter hiding places in order with a hint each; makes printable numbered clue cards pointing to the next spot.
Enter cards by form or pasted CSV with title, text and image; lays them out on printable sheets.
Simulated shell over a fake filesystem; puzzles teach ls, cd, cat, grep and mv one step at a time.
A note appears on a staff; press the matching key on an on-screen piano; synthesized sound, score and streak.
Open audio or video; plays it while jumping over parts below a volume threshold you set.
Open audio; shortcut keys for play, rewind 3 seconds, speed 0.5x to 2x; text box with timestamp insert.
Microphone audio plays back to your headphones after a delay you set from 0 to 10 seconds.
Open an .epub; unzips locally, shows chapters with a table of contents, font size and remembered position.
Open an .mbox file; lists messages by date, sender and subject; read bodies and search.
Drop a file; reads its magic bytes and reports the actual format versus its extension.
Drop files; computes SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5; compares against a pasted expected hash.
Select JPG files; writes one PDF embedding the original JPEG bytes, one per page, no recompression.
Open a file; hex and ASCII columns with offsets, jump to offset, search for bytes or text.
Type a regex, flags and test text; live match highlights, capture groups and a plain reading of each token.
Open or paste large JSON; collapsible tree, search, copy path; stays responsive on tens of megabytes.
Type text, a link or wifi details; generates the QR code locally; download PNG or SVG.
Generates passphrases from an embedded word list; choose words, separator, digits; shows strength in bits.
Load an image, mark a reference line of known length; click points to measure distances and areas.
Add images or draw frames, set delay per frame; encodes an animated GIF locally for download.
Draw on a pixel grid that wraps at the edges with a live 3x3 tiled preview; export PNG.
Pick face shape, features and colors or randomize; generates a portrait avatar; export SVG or PNG.
Load an image; lists its dominant colors with hex codes and share of pixels; copy the palette.
Brushes, eraser, colors, sizes and undo on a canvas that works with finger or stylus; save PNG.
Add nodes or type an indented outline; draws a draggable mind map; export SVG, PNG and JSON.
Add boxes, decisions and arrows, drag and label them; export SVG or PNG.
Build equations with buttons for fractions, roots, powers and symbols; renders the math; copy as LaTeX.
Place points, lines and circles with intersections; drag points and the construction updates; measure lengths and angles.
Type z = f(x, y); renders a rotatable shaded 3D surface on canvas with axis ranges.
Load a chart image, calibrate both axes with two clicks each; click points to read data; export CSV.
Edit Brainfuck code; run or step through it; shows the tape, pointer, input and output.
Big shapes and colors that make sounds and animate when tapped; nothing to lose, no reading needed.
A parent writes a short book and locks the text; pictures on each page can be swapped for family photos.
Paste a table of numbers with labels; draws a colored heatmap with a scale; export PNG or SVG.
Load a scanned page image; draw solid black boxes; exports a flattened PNG with the covered pixels gone.
Store recipes with ingredients; pick meals for the week; get one merged shopping list.
Pick base colors; preview sample code highlighted live; export as VS Code and Vim theme files.
Load a screenshot; wraps it in a light or dark browser window frame with shadow; export PNG.
Type a chord name; shows fingering diagrams with alternate voicings; plays the chord.
Open a video; pause to draw on frames; drawings reappear at their times; export annotated frames as PNG.
Open two to four local videos; play them in sync in a grid with per-video offsets.
Open a video; grab the current frame or one every N seconds; download as images.
Fill in CV sections; live preview; download the finished personal site as one HTML file.
Enter your details, client, line items and tax; shows a printable invoice; remembers invoice numbers.
Write or open Fountain text; renders standard screenplay layout; print to PDF.
Log expenses by category; set monthly budgets; shows what remains and a category chart.
Tap a day to mark it vegetarian; month calendar, current streak and yearly share.
Record bottles with vintage, rack location and drink window; search, counts and a drink-now list.
Dated daily entries with search and a weekly view; export everything as Markdown.
One full-page text area that saves itself on the device; word count; nothing else.
Calculator showing hex, decimal, octal and binary at once with bitwise ops, shifts and word sizes.
Paste or open two texts; shows line and word differences side by side or inline.
Paste two lists one item per line; shows items only in A, only in B and in both.
Paste a document; lists repeated sentences and phrases by length and count, highlighted in the text.
Pick an ingredient and amount; converts grams to cups, mL and spoons using ingredient densities.
Paste base64, hex or text; converts between all three live, with file input too.
Paste or open JSON, CSV, XML or YAML; converts to any of the others; download the result.
Paste HTML or rich text; converts it to clean Markdown with a preview.
Set work and break lengths; full-screen break prompt with countdown that is hard to skip; eye-rest tips.
A clean countdown timer and stopwatch with laps, big digits and a sound at zero.
Add, check off, reorder and delete tasks; saved on the device; nothing else.
25-minute work and 5-minute break cycles with adjustable lengths, sound and a count of rounds.
Convert length, mass, volume, temperature, area, speed, time and data units as you type.

reserve.spec_hint: Four players' points per hand, running totals and dealer rotation; editable scoring values.
Define small tables; write selection, projection, join and set expressions; shows result tables.
Open an .ics file; lists its events in agenda and month views with details.
Open an .eml file; decodes its MIME parts and offers each attachment for download.
Place chords on a timeline; plays them with synthesized voicings; tempo and loop.
Enter roles and names; plays scrolling end credits full screen at an adjustable speed.
Type a list; renders it as a process, cycle, pyramid or hierarchy graphic; export SVG or PNG.
Generates a map of polygon regions; paint terrain and name regions; export PNG.
Log an item and where it is; search to find it; saved on the device.
Short drills for n-back, digit span and reaction time with local best scores.
Choose a register length; finds tap masks with maximal period and checks a given mask.
Edit a grid or paste CSV; outputs LaTeX tabular code with alignment and rules.
Type the alarm time on number keys; big clock and an alarm sound while the page is open.
Draw and edit SVG shapes, paths and text; edit attributes; open and save .svg files.
Paste two XML documents; structural diff of elements, attributes and text.
Write or open Markdown; styled preview; print to PDF with page breaks and no LaTeX.
Open an Apache access log; parsed table with filters, top paths, status codes and hourly chart.
Load two images; reports whether their pixels are exactly identical, ignoring metadata.
Notes and links arranged in a collapsible tree; drag to reorder; search; export JSON.
Enter tasks with start, duration and dependencies; draws a Gantt chart; export PNG.
Type tables and fields in a short text syntax; draws an entity-relationship diagram; export SVG.
List layers with sizes; draws a convolutional network block diagram; export SVG.
Write techs and prerequisites as text; renders a layered tech tree; export SVG.
Plays intervals or chords; you name them; tracks accuracy per type.
Record or use the microphone; apply pitch, robot and echo effects; download the result.
Keeps the last N minutes of microphone audio in memory; save that slice on tap.
Open an audio file; draws its waveform with chosen colors and size; export PNG or SVG.
Select many images; resize to a max size or percent and recompress; download them all.
Load a scan of several photos; detects or lets you draw each one; saves them as separate images.
Load a screenshot; drag boxes to pixelate or blur text; export PNG.
Load a sprite or icon sheet; set grid or detect icons; download each as its own PNG.
Enter name, phone and email; makes a vCard QR code someone else can scan.
Add books with title, author, location and loaned-to; search and sort; export CSV.
Log workouts with exercise, sets, reps and weight; progress charts; data stays on the device.
Enter place, date and time; shows the sun's altitude and direction on a sky dome.
Pick a chord progression; generates and plays a random melody that fits it; reroll.
Type letters or words; lists anagrams from an embedded English word list.
Paste CSS selectors; shows each specificity score and which one wins.
Diary entries encrypted on the device with a passphrase; lock, unlock and export.
Open an audio file; loops it or a selected section with no gap.
